name: manual_b9933c
claim: A bare lan_peer_assign drop --peer defaulted to the plain portal port whatever the TLS settings were: it timed out when only the HTTPS front end was reachable and left a queued record stored on the wrong port. Pass the TLS port explicitly or use lan_peer_send.py; the default now follows the TLS configuration (orama PR 491).

decisions.notes: Two sends failed the same way on 2026-11-10 (a broadcast and a manual report); the fix and its tests are in orama PR 491.
